description: Fontaines à boire is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Eau de Paris. Localisation des fontaines à boire Eau de Paris sur les espaces gérés par la Ville de Paris. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Bâtiment - équipements, Cadre de vie - environnement. Its keywords are Eau potable, Eau, Canicule. The portal shows 1,323 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
